description: Sub-project 1 of 3 of NFRA_PIPELINE (CTO PRD c925611f0, Andrew-direct 2026-07-02). Walk the 49F partner pipeline END-TO-END -- first resource (EventBridge trigger) through bronze->silver->gold->platinum->portal (the ADVI 49F served surface + the MDPF custody aggregate two-tier: build platinum/mdpf -> served portal-v2/json) -- with /seams + /molecule + /code-review, to establish the ABSOLUTE-TRUTH resource manifest (SSOT), then decommission every deprecated/floating/un-Terraform'd resource (SAFE-decommission only, comp-blast zero-consumer, unrecoverable=human-gated) and make the 49F Terraform rock-solid + applied (live==TF==applied, 0-drift). ORTHOGONAL to ADVI_ETLFIX (that = data-correct; this = resource-truth + estate hygiene); the /seams+/molecule pass ALSO independently re-verifies the 49F ETLFIX work. Firm-scoped (bd + schwab; NEVER cross to cot/inf, Rule 13). Method + deliverables + ACs: NFRA_PIPELINE_PRD.md sections 2/4/7.
